title: Rabbi Yose of Caesarea
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in an aggadic passage in Sanhedrin 101a. In Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, at the printed locator קלב. (132), he disagrees with Resh Lakish. Eichah Rabbah 4:18 reads Rabbi Afi of Caesarea; this is what Seder HaDorot means.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The notice has the form אפי, Afi, and the contextual variant-reading formula גרם. The printed Pesikta locator קלב. is retained without establishing its edition or page-versus-folio convention.

The complete Eikhah Rabbah 4:18 scalar has Rabbi Assi of Caesarea beside Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish, while Hyman supplies Afi. A separately obtained complete Sanhedrin 108a discourse names Rabbi Yose of Caesarea; Hyman cites 101a. His Pesikta locator קלב. and his interpretation of Seder HaDorot remain unverified reports about an unspecified edition. These comparisons do not repair Afi, the supplied גרם, or either locator.
